detail.longDescription: https://www. theguardian.com/us-news/2026/n ov/01/chatgpt-woman-seizure-lawsuit-openai Bowen Wan, a 31-year-old Chinese software engineer living in Seattle, sought advice from ChatGPT after Amazon fired her, according to the lawsuit. She needed to find a new job to obtain permanent residency and was concerned that her anti-seizure medication, Lamotrigine, was impeding her ability to speak English. She needed the language skills for interviews. The bot, communicating in Chinese, provided her a tapering schedule to reduce her 400mg dose to zero, a regimen no physician had prescribed, the lawsuit states. ChatGPT told her the tapering made it “highly likely” that she would be able to regain her ability to speak English. The bot also told her to avoid her physicians and encouraged “medical freedom over obeying the doctor”, the complaint states. Before an appointment, with a primary care physician, the bot stated, “Do not mention Lam reduction plan.” # uspol # chatGPT # exploitation # classwar # horror # demonic # samAltman # wrongfulDeath # ai # openai
